orgName: Dubai World Cup meeting (Dubai Racing Club)

source.name: Emirates 24|7 - Magnitude Wins Dubai World Cup 2026 at Meydan Racecourse
source.note: 'Magnitude secured the $6.96 million winner's prize from the total $12 million purse sponsored by Emirates.' Meeting total purse US$30.5m across nine races (dubairacingclub.com).

note: Race title sponsor of the $12m Dubai World Cup, 2026; Emirates is also official airline of the Dubai Racing Carnival (dubairacingclub.com/sponsors-partners). Fee not published.
